t: Bzzt! Scout unit DX-4 online.
The bridge crosses the canyon to the east trading post. Mind the lava falls!
Beep-boop. Field tip:
Open your Bag in battle to heal with Med Gel, or use a Revive Spark on a fainted Alienmon.
Press START anywhere to use healing items between battles.
Explorer: Want to catch something rare?
Use a Tether Pulse to weaken it without knocking it out, then a Stun Spray.
Weak and shocked Alienmon give you a much wider Sync window. Then fire the transfer beam from your Bag!
Wanderer: Name's Dusty. I've lived on this rim since the Starfall.
That crater past the falls? The seedpods came down hot as stars twenty years back.
Drift grass grows in the cactus gardens down south. Wild Alienmon love to hide in it.
The holo-globe maps all fourteen worlds of the Kessler system.
A faint red line pulses from the Starfall crater... toward something far beyond the edge of the map.
Sola: Took you long enough to get up here.
The twins at the top of the stairs read minds. Don't let them see your next move coming!

hot.t: The little green Alienmon squeaks and charges!

t: Bzzt. Skyreach Plaza floats 2,000 meters above the cloud sea.
Updrafts keep the islands aloft. Please do not jump.
Beep. The garden on the east terrace is full of drift ferns. Wild Psi-types nest there.

hot.t: The glowing Alienmon flickers and attacks!
The one-eyed Alienmon blinks at you... then pounces!

t: Wanderer: I came up here chasing a Novaling sighting.
They say it only appears when all eight Shards sing together.
Kid: My dad says the Alienmon came from the sky before I was born!
I'm gonna be a Linker just like you someday.

hot.t: The pink Alienmon puffs up its gills. It wants to battle!

t: Dr. Vashti: Good, you made it to Neonis!
I've tuned your ship's Recovery Bay. Talk to it any time to heal your team or restock.
Bzzt. Docking clamps engaged. Your vessel is cleared for launch whenever you're ready.
Sola: Nice ship. Mine's faster.
DJ Static runs the tower up those stairs. His Volt team hits like a power surge.
Technician: Running diagnostics on the relay dish.
Helix Directive ships keep pinging our frequencies. Something big is coming.
